from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter,deque
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
r,g,b=im.transpose(2,0,1)
# blue dominance masks variants
for name,m in [
('b-r30',(b>r+30)&(b>g+10)),('blue',(b>r*1.3)&(b>g*1.05)&(b>70)),('satblue',(b-r>20)&(b-g>0)&(b>80)),('deep',(b>80)&(b-r>40))]:
 ys,xs=np.where(m)
 print(name,len(xs), (xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None)
 # hist location coarse
 H=np.zeros((9,16),int)
 np.add.at(H,(ys//80,xs//80),1)
 inds=np.argwhere(H>0)
 print(sorted([(H[y,x],x*80,y*80) for y,x in inds],reverse=True)[:15])
# kmeans colors via sklearn? sample
from sklearn.cluster import MiniBatchKMeans
s=im[::4,::4].reshape(-1,3)
k=MiniBatchKMeans(12,random_state=0,n_init=3,batch_size=4096).fit(s)
for c,n in sorted(zip(k.cluster_centers_,np.bincount(k.labels_)), key=lambda z:-z[1]):print(n,np.round(c,1))
